providers.name: AzerothCore Playerbots
providers.description: Standard Wrath 3.3.5a realm with autonomous Playerbots.

profiles.name: Progressive 1–80
profiles.description: Start at level 1 and progress through Classic, The Burning Crusade and Wrath content.

profiles.name: Instant Level 80
profiles.description: Level 80 characters with starter gear for dungeons, raids and battlegrounds.

profiles.name: Custom Realm
profiles.description: Choose rates, level cap, bot population and optional modules yourself.

modules.name: Playerbots
modules.description: Adds autonomous characters that quest, group, raid and participate in PvP.

modules.name: Dungeon Clear
modules.description: Improves playerbot dungeon movement, pulls and recovery between encounters.

modules.name: AutoBalance
modules.description: Scales dungeon and raid enemies to the number and strength of players.

modules.name: AoE Loot
modules.description: Loot all nearby defeated creatures with one interaction.

modules.name: Transmogrification
modules.description: Change an item's appearance while keeping its original stats.

modules.name: Learn Spells
modules.description: Automatically teaches appropriate class spells while leveling.

modules.name: Auction House Bot
modules.description: Keeps the auction house populated with believable supply and demand.

modules.name: Individual XP
modules.description: Allows separate experience multipliers for individual players.

modules.name: SoloCraft
modules.description: Adds optional stat scaling for solo and undersized group content.

modules.name: Multibot Bridge
modules.description: Provides the server bridge used by compatible multibot control addons.

providers.name: Conquest of Azeroth
providers.description: Experimental open-source CoA adaptation for the matching user-supplied Ascension client.

profiles.name: Conquest of Azeroth
profiles.description: Custom CoA classes and progression using the matching Ascension native-v4 client.

modules.name: Ascension Compatibility
modules.description: Required CoA protocol and class compatibility included with the source.

modules.name: AutoBalance Solo Dungeons
modules.description: Scales dungeon and raid creatures for the actual player count. Experimental with CoA.
